subject: 3b: Backfill — purge existing ~70 stale-claim continuity notes from the graph
description:
Once 3a lands (releaseClaim no longer creates these), backfill-clean the ~70 existing "Continuity: stale claim reset" note nodes already in the graph so RAG recall and the judge stop seeing them.

SCOPE: a one-shot migration. Identify note nodes whose title starts with "Continuity: stale claim reset" (check .graph/nodes/note:* files and the overlay). For each: remove the note node AND its context edges from the overlay/graph-store, OR archive them out of the RAG candidate pool + judge clustering if the store supports soft-archive (prefer whichever matches how other notes are retired — check supersede_note / archive semantics in lib/overlay.js and graph-store.js). Do NOT delete anything that 3a's resolution determined is still load-bearing for claim-context (coordinate: 3a is a blocking prerequisite).

DELIVERABLE: the ~70 continuity notes no longer appear in search_knowledge results or judge clusters; edges cleaned; graph-store round-trips cleanly (reload + checkpoint). Verify count before/after. The daemon likely needs a restart to reload the cleaned store — if so, emit that as a disruptive follow_up via complete_task (do NOT restart yourself). Run the full test suite green.

summary: Retired 31 CURRENT "Continuity: stale claim reset" note nodes (authoritative loadGraph count: 71 total continuity notes, 40 already retired, 31 current → 0 current after). Mechanism: appended a note_superseded event with validTo set and NO supersededBy (retire-without-replacement — there is no hard-delete event type, and these auto-generated transients have no successor). This is the existing retirement primitive; non-current notes are excluded from default search_knowledge, the gated RAG candidate pool, and judge buildQueue/dup-cluster passes, while preserved as bitemporal history. Store round-trips cleanly (post-reload verify: 0 still current; idempotent re-run confirms 71/71 retired). Script committed in worktree at scripts/retire-continuity-notes.js (commit 45050ab) and already APPLIED to the live main .graph store. Touched NO production code — standalone migration; test suite identical to base HEAD (114/129 files pass, same 15 known pre-existing sandbox-integration failures, ZERO new failures). DAEMON RESTART REQUIRED: note_nodes live only in the graph-store event log and in the running daemon's in-memory state.overlay (not in overlay LOCAL_FIELDS), so the persisted store is now clean but the live daemon still returns these as current:true until reloaded — verified via live search_knowledge. Filed as disruptive follow_up. Did NOT touch the load-bearing note "stale claim continuity reaches next claimer via task note not a note node" (different title, 3a's finding).
